summary: Colville NF summit lookout: 1926 detection site, 50-ft L-4 tower from 1939, removed 1958. The brief's Fosback move belongs to a separate Stevens County tower.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1958 per firetower.org and Rex's page; firelookout.com says destroyed. No source read describes it as standing.

corrections.why: The register, firelookout.com and Rex's page all say the Colville NF tower was removed or destroyed in 1958. The Fosback move belongs to a different record, the Stevens County site (US 1514).

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to Fosback.)
corrections.why: Rod Fosback's tower is the Stevens County Monumental Mountain site, which was purchased and rebuilt east of Colville. The Colville NF record shows no move.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's page say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed. The story reports both words and does not pick one, since no source explains how the tower ended.

notes_for_editor: The brief's relocated status and Fosback event come from a different record. Its source link (../us-wa-monumental-mountain-lookout-site-at-fosback/) points at the Stevens County site (US 1514, owned by Rod Fosback), which is the likely cause of the mix-up. Facts for the Colville NF site: built 1926, replaced 1939, removed or destroyed 1958. The height_m of 15.2 is 50 ft converted to metres. Not verified: anything at the summit today, public access, and any staffing after 1930. The Stevens County site has its own conflicting dates (1996 removal per firetower.org, 1998 sale per WillhiteWeb) that matter for the separate record. No photos added: the FFLOS record already holds three Colville NF photos.
